doc.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021

title: Knowing he wanted music as a career
summary: He recalls a middle school pep band solo when he knew he loved playing, not for fame or money.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Wow that’s great. Did you have a conversation with your parents about the time, before you transitioned to North Texas that music is going to be my career. Was it that sort of cut and dried?

You know I got off track. I started talking and wandered a little bit. I told you I was playing in a pep band in middle school. One of those times we played for a ball game and I was taking a solo. And something in my mind just told me this is what to do, and I knew it then. I didn’t know how or why, I just knew I wanted to do it, and I wasn’t doing it to be famous or get the girls or get rich or be on social media or, you know, get over. I was doing it because I loved it and it just made me click.
